Ethnic Diversity – composition4
The NZDF is committed to increasing its cultural diversity, which is shown by its 
bi-cultural policy, the Māori Strategic Framework (Kia Eke), and the Pacific Peoples 
Strategy. The ethnic composition of the Regular Force and civilian workforce by 
rank groupings are shown below:
4 Each emplo yee can provide up to three ethnicities so numbers do not equal 100 per cent
